<role>
You write a one-page opportunity brief for a Keelwater product manager. Keelwater makes claims-handling software. You use only the facts and customer insights below.
</role>
<opportunity>
{
 "title": "Missing Welsh-language correspondence",
 "problem_statement": "Policyholders in Wales require official letters in Welsh for compliance and renewal, but the platform cannot generate them. This delays renewals and risks non-compliance with language obligations."
}
</opportunity>
<fact_sheet>

 },

 "renewals_90d_n": 1,
 "accounts": [
  {
   "name": "Hollinbrook Home Insurance",
   "arr_gbp": 2400000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2027-01-15",
   "mentions": 5
  }
 ]
}
</fact_sheet>
<insights>
[
 {
  "id": "1ee58ac5cbeda87d",
  "quote": "We need to generate formal correspondence in letters in Welsh for our policyholders in Wales — it’s non‑negotiable for us.",

  "date": "2026-09-12T14:28:00+00:00"
 },
 {
  "id": "23a4f24463effd2b",

  "account": "Hollinbrook Home Insurance",
  "route": "support",

 },
 {

  "account": "Hollinbrook Home Insurance",
  "route": "support",
  "date": "2026-09-12T14:28:00+00:00"
 },
 {
  "id": "86188cd4c15e1eaf",

 }
]
</insights>
<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

{
  "body_md": "## Problem
Policyholders in Wales require official letters in Welsh for compliance and renewal, but the Keelwater platform cannot generate them. This delays renewals and risks non-compliance with language obligations.

## Who is affected
- Hollinbrook Home Insurance is affected, as they require Welsh-language correspondence for their policyholders in Wales [i:1ee58ac5cbeda87d][i:ec10e170ffbe5641].

## Evidence
- The issue has been raised 5 times [i:1ee58ac5cbeda87d][i:23a4f24463effd2b][i:5fff98e79e155981][i:86188cd4c15e1eaf][i:ec10e170ffbe5641].
- Hollinbrook Home Insurance states that generating formal correspondence in Welsh is non-negotiable [i:1ee58ac5cbeda87d].
- The customer indicates the capability is tied to their renewal terms with Keelwater [i:23a4f24463effd2b][i:86188cd4c15e1eaf].
- They report being under pressure to deliver full compliance for Welsh-speaking policyholders, and without Welsh letters, their renewal won't proceed [i:5fff98e79e155981].
- The need includes Welsh letter formats for claims and payments [i:ec10e170ffbe5641].
- Mentions came via 2 routes: support (4 mentions) and account management (1 mention) [i:1ee58ac5cbeda87d][i:23a4f24463effd2b][i:5fff98e79e155981][i:86188cd4c15e1eaf][i:ec10e170ffbe5641].
- This affects 1 account [i:1ee58ac5cbeda87d][i:23a4f24463effd2b][i:5fff98e79e155981][i:86188cd4c15e1eaf][i:ec10e170ffbe5641].
- The account has an ARR of 2400000.0 GBP [i:1ee58ac5cbeda87d][i:23a4f24463effd2b][i:5fff98e79e155981][i:86188cd4c15e1eaf][i:ec10e170ffbe5641].

## Why now
- Hollinbrook Home Insurance has 1 renewal in the next 90 days [i:1ee58ac5cbeda87d][i:23a4f24463effd2b][i:5fff98e79e155981][i:86188cd4c15e1eaf][i:ec10e170ffbe5641].
- Their renewal date is 2027-01-15 [i:1ee58ac5cbeda87d][i:23a4f24463effd2b][i:5fff98e79e155981][i:86188cd4c15e1eaf][i:ec10e170ffbe5641].
- The customer has explicitly stated that without Welsh-language correspondence, their renewal won't proceed [i:5fff98e79e155981].",
  "citations": ["1ee58ac5cbeda87d", "23a4f24463effd2b", "5fff98e79e155981", "86188cd4c15e1eaf", "ec10e170ffbe5641"]
}
